answer: The raiser sets his staves in the raising ring, and the ring must hold them upright while the hoops go on. Keg chestnut stave steamer chime charter covers the raising: a charter chestnut stave steamers file after steaming chest checks. The delta is the first stave set, the knoll is the last before the trussing, and the onyx is the ring itself, iron-bound and steady. A cheat must set 31 false staves and truss 31 false rings.
